sections.title: II. Read the passage carefully, then choose the correct answer (A, B, C or D) for the questions below. (1,25 points)
sections.introHtml:
Dear Nam, I'm glad to receive your email. Now I'm going to tell you about my house.

My house is quite big. It has two floors. It also has an attic. On the ground floor, there is the hall, the kitchen, the living room and a dining room.

On the first floor, there are three bedrooms and a big bathroom. My bedroom is between my parents' bedroom and the bathroom. My brother's bedroom is in front of my bedroom. I love the attic the most. In the attic, I keep my books and my old toys. I like to spend my time there because it's quiet and I can do anything I like.

What about your house? Tell me in your next email.

Best,

Mike.

sections.title: III. Write a paragraph (about 70 – 80 words) about your house (1,0 point)

questions.html:

How many rooms are there in your house ?

Which room do you like best in your house ?

Why do you like your house ?

The end
questions.referenceHtml:
You can use the following questions as cues:

Where is your house?

How many rooms are there in your house?

Which room do you like best in your house?

Why do you like your house?

My house is in the city center. It is not very big, but it is clean and comfortable. There are six rooms in my house: a living room, a kitchen, two bedrooms, a bathroom, and a dining room. My favourite room is my bedroom because I can study, read books, and relax there. I love my house because my family always spends time together, and it is a warm, happy place to live. (73 words)

The end
